discussion list.--web: Opens the system browser instead of listing through the API; the harness intentionally sets GH_BROWSER=false and cannot assert browser navigation.

discussion view.--web: Opens the system browser; browser rendering/navigation is outside the noninteractive real-gh harness (GH_BROWSER=false).

issue comment.--editor: Launches an interactive external text editor. The harness fixes GH_EDITOR=false and provides no TTY; --body and --body-file exercise submitted comment contents.
issue comment.--web: Opens the browser's comment composer rather than submitting a comment through gh; the harness disables browser launches.

issue create.--editor: Launches an interactive external editor for title/body. GH_EDITOR=false and the non-TTY harness cannot author or accept its buffer.
issue create.--template: Template starting-body selection is part of the interactive issue-authoring/editor flow; supplying --title and --body noninteractively bypasses that flow. The harness disables prompts and external editors, so it cannot accept a template-prefilled buffer.
issue create.--web: Opens an issue-creation browser form instead of submitting a gh API mutation; GH_BROWSER=false deliberately prevents browser launches.

issue list.--web: Opens the browser's issue list; the harness disables browser launches and cannot assert browser-side filtering.

issue view.--web: Opens the system browser instead of rendering issue output; browser navigation is not observable in this noninteractive harness.

label list.--web: Opens the repository labels page in a browser. GH_BROWSER=false and no browser session is available for a meaningful assertion.
